title: Cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Within this face, draw a single loop, and within this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.006, 0.006) with a radius of 0.006 units. After drawing the circle, apply a scaling factor of 0.012 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using Euler angles of (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translate it using the translation vector (0.0, 0.0, 0.0). Finally, extrude the scaled two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that this operation creates a new solid body. The final cylindrical object will have a length of 0.012 units, a width of 0.012 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.006, 0.006)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.006)         # Draw a circle with radius 0.006
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)         # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder of height 0.75
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the final model

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a cylindrical rod with diameter 0.012 and height 0.75
rod = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(0.006)
    .extrude(0.75)
)

# The top view shows a small concentric feature at the top;
# add a slight chamfer to the top edge for detail.
rod = rod.faces(">Z").chamfer(0.0005)

r = rod
